title: Admin panel — choose the layout
question: Colours and fonts stay Family Group's own. Pick how the admin is organised.

options.label: Action inbox
options.lineage: mail client three-pane + airport gate board
options.thesis: Everything that needs a person — new orders, call-back requests, low stock, expiring certificates — lands in one queue that stays lit until someone opens it.
options.viewport: Narrow espresso rail on the left; a queue list of today's items in the middle; the opened order (customer, map pin, items, status buttons) on the right.
options.risk: Analytics and catalog pages sit one click further away than in a classic dashboard.

regions.label: queue: new orders, requests, low stock
opened order: customer, map, items, status

options.label: Pharmacy counter
options.lineage: classic admin: grouped side menu + dashboard
options.thesis: A familiar side menu grouped by job (Sales, Catalog, Network, System); the home screen shows today's queue, the money, and stock drawn as bottles filling up.
options.viewport: Wide espresso side menu with section labels; KPI strip across the top; revenue chart and today's queue side by side; low-stock bottles below.
options.risk: The most familiar layout of the three, so it's the least surprising.

options.label: Owner's ledger
options.thesis: Top navigation and a wide, numbers-first home: revenue, top sellers and a map of sales by city lead; Ctrl+K jumps to any order or product.
options.viewport: Espresso top bar with section tabs; a row of big KPI numbers with small trend lines; sales map of Uzbekistan beside top sellers; orders table below.
options.risk: Best for the owner; operators processing orders all day get fewer shortcuts.
